book.name: 1 Uyohana
book.title: Ubvur uwu inggbaashia Uyohana aka atsɛng

content: A aze angwɛ̃mum, umum itsɛnga umbi akɛrɛ utsur umbi agbambi ra arhim. Bɔr unera aba agba ra arhim, umɛn iwemɛn ru uwuku urherha arherhe nggu Utɛ, uwuku ukaa umɛn, Uyesu Ukiristo uwuku urhurhika ha.
Unga awu idɛm-Num iyiki itsũwe arhimmɛn, asi iwea akimɛn ukpekũ nu aki anera kishoo ru upfunga ikɛi.
Umɛn ĩba ĩdɔsumɛn ikpem Unum, mɔcɛ umɛn ihwɛngmɛn ugɛ umɛn ihwɛngmɛn unga.
Unera aba agɔr agɛ, <<Umum ihwɛng unga,>> bɔr asi ikorhunga ubinkpi ikpemnga iki irherhe, unga agbɛrangwĩ, nu idzidzɛrhe ishingge ru unga.
Bɔr unera aba adɔsunga urhɛm Unum, idzidzɛrhe ibibemu Unum ighwɛrngge ikpũrhã ru unga. Akɛrɛ atsu umɛn ihwɛng ugɛ umɛn iwemɛn ru unga.
Ubɛn unera aka agɔr agɛ unga abɛk ru unga, awu ufang unga azɛ̃rhã ru nyaka Uyesu aka akorhe.
A aze awɛrhamum, umum isi itsɛngamum umbi ikpem iyiki ifa bɔr iyiki igbe, iyi ha umbi aka ayɛi ri inggbaashia. Ikpem iki igbe ha iwu isarhayɛ umbi aka agũ ri nyaku iki ifa ha.
Ikpem hã ikɛi iwu iyiki ifa. Idzidzɛrhangge anyã ngge ru unga nu umbi, ubinkutsu uzĩ uni ititɔng nu irhirhang idzidzɛrhe iki ini irhang.
Ubɛn unera aka agɔr agɛ unga awe ru irhirhang hã bɔr unga akpɛ̃ɛ̃ ungwɛ̃mbɔ use unapumbɔ, ana awe ru uzĩ.
Uwuruwi aka abemu ungwɛ̃mbɔ use unapumbɔ awu ri irhirhang hã, nu utarh ukpuku ukwɛr itok ushikpɔ ru unga.
Bɔr uwuruwi aka akpɛ̃ɛ̃ ungwɛ̃mbɔ use unapumbɔ awe ru uzĩ, azɛ̃rhã akɔn ru uzĩ. Asi ihwɛnga anangkɛ unga aka izĩ, ubinkutsu uzĩ uku utsu unga itapa.

content.text: ubinkutsu aka atsũwãmbɔ arhimmbi ri itsinga.
ubinkutsu umbi ahwɛngmbi unga uwu ha aka awe ri inggbaashia.
ubinkutsu umbi aka anangmbi uwuku ubewe ha.
ubinkutsu, umbi ahwɛngmbi unga uwu ha aka awe ri inggbaashia.
nu umbi aka anangmbi uwuku ubewe ha.

content: Àka niba abemumbi upfung use abinkɛ aka awe ru upfung. Ubɛn unera aka abemu upfung, ibibemu Utɛ ha ishingge ru unga.
Ubɛn ubinkpi uku uwe ru upfung ru nyaki ikponi iyor, nu unyɛ̃ɛ̃ asu nu ifĩrhã abinkɛ umɛn iki iwu ra ake, ake asi idzeke ru Utɛ, bɔr adzeka ru upfung.
Upfung nu abin ikponi iyorke awuri itɔng, bɔr uwuruwi aka akorha abinkɛ Unum aka abee, awuri ibɛka ugbagbaa.
Igbiir ato ra abika akpɛ̃ Ukiristo
A aze angwɛ̃mum, ivang iyiki imimasha riyɛ. Ru nyaka umbi aka agũ agɛ, uwuku ukpɛ̃ Ukiristo uwɔ abarɔ, uko icɛrɛ arhɛrha abika akpɛ̃ Ukiristo aka abambɔ. Ngge itsu umɛn ihwɛng ivang imimasha iyɛrɛ.
Umbɔ adzeku umɛn, bɔr asi iwembɔ abimɛn. Agɛ umbɔ awe abimɛn, umbɔ asei nggu umɛn, bɔr uzɛ̃rhãmbɔ udɛyiwe ukupɛ̃ɛ̃ ugɛ uko unying ru umbɔ asi iwea uwu umɛn.
Bɔr umbɔ aka adzaambɔ umbi Ipfu Isarsatangge, nu kishoo umbi ahwɛngmbi idzidzɛrhe.
Umum itsɛnga umbi akɛrɛ, asi iwea ugɛ umbi asi ihwɛngmbi idzidzɛrhe, bɔr umbi ahwɛngmbi ngge, ikɛi umbi ahwɛngmbi ugɛ idzidzɛrhe isi isaki imarngge igbɛrangwĩ.
Ungamɔ awu uner igbɛrangwĩ? Awu uner ha aka atsɛyi ugɛ Uyesu asi iwea Ukiristo. Ikpũ uner ha awu uwuku ukpɛ̃ Ukiristo, unga atsɛyinga Utɛ nu Ungwɛ̃.
Unera ashia aka itsɛyi Ungwɛ̃, na awea ru Utɛ. Bɔr ubɛn unera aka ayɛisa Ungwɛ̃, aka ayɛi Utɛ nukpɔ.
Àka atsu amɛnmbi ri imesayɛ umbi aka agũ ri inggbaashia iwe ru umbi. Iba iwengge, umbi awuri iseimbi ru Ungwɛ̃ nu Utɛ.
Akɛrɛ ha ake awe ibibemuwe ha unga aka abemuwa umɛn uko urhɛ uwu ugbagbaa.
Umum itsɛnga umbi akɛrɛ ra arherhe abirabɛ aka abee itsu umbi ayapa.

Bɔr umbi aka ayɛimbi Ipfu Isarsatangge, unga asei ru umbi, nu umbi asi ibeembi uner uwɔɔ amesuwa umbi. Bɔr Ipfu ha imesuwangge umbi ubɛn ubinkpi uku umɛ̃ɛ̃ umbi ahwɛng, nu abinkɛ unga aka amesuwa awu idzidzɛrhe, asi iweke igbɛrangwĩ. Ru nyaka unga aka amesuwa umbi, àka asei ri iwɛrhɛ ru Ukiristo.
Angwɛ̃ Unum
Icɛrɛ umbi aze awɛkaci, àka asei ru Ukiristo, ngge itsú ivangyɛ unga aka idzeka, umɛn ima iwe ru ikeramɛn isi ígũmɛn atsa ra asunga.
Umbi aba ahwɛngmbi agɛ unga arhiku uner, umbi ahwɛngmbi agɛ ubɛn unera aka akorhi ifɛrhɛ iyiki irhirhika, awu Ukiristo amar uner ha.
